card.name: Words leading into recurrence or frequency
card.fires_on: Words that set up a repeating interval or lasting prevention, such as "every" or "per" after a dose or amount, and "prevent" or "recurring" in sentences about stopping a problem from returning.

modes.label: Dose interval word
modes.description: "every" or "per" right after an amount or unit, introducing how often it is given or used.
modes.example: reduce dosage to 60 mg<< every>> 4 weeks.

modes.label: Preventing recurrence
modes.description: Verbs about stopping something from coming back or persisting.
modes.example: to get rid of the present brown algae bloom and<< prevent>> future outbreaks.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about lasting or permanent effect, such as "permanent".
card.plain: It lights up on words that say how often something happens or that something should be kept from coming back.
